svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, per supply (860 W at 200-240 VAC and 240 VDC, 800 W at 100-127 VAC)
svg.data-fans: five 40 x 40 x 56 mm counter-rotating PWM fans, with space for a sixth
svg.data-cpu: one 4th or 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processor, socket E (LGA-4677), up to 300 W TDP
svg.data-memory: 8 DDR5 DIMM slots, up to 2 TB of 5600 MT/s ECC RDIMM
svg.data-storage-controller: onboard SATA, 6 Gbps; NVMe and SAS need the optional cables or controller card
svg.data-regulatory: FCC, ICES, CE, UKCA, VCCI, RCM, NRTL, CB
